SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT si.id_student)
FROM studentInfo si
JOIN assessments a ON si.code_module = a.code_module AND si.code_presentation = a.code_presentation
JOIN studentAssessment sa ON a.id_assessment = sa.id_assessment AND si.id_student = sa.id_student
WHERE a.assessment_type = 'Exam'
  AND sa.score < 40
  AND si.final_result IN ('Pass', 'Distinction')
